column1: # Which hook runs for which event and tool (#133). .claude/settings.json calls
# .sdlc/hooks/dispatch.sh <event> once per event, and the dispatcher runs each matching row
# in order, so a new or changed hook is a change here, never in the project's settings.
# Columns, tab-separated: event, tool (a regex for the tool's name, or * for any), command
# (relative to the repo root). A project adds its own rows in .sdlc-local/hooks/hooks.tsv,
# which run after these; it can't remove or replace these.
